title: Signal: Test environment installs unpinned requirements
scope: A tox.ini file that declares a `testenv.deps` list in which no requirement is pinned with `==`.
limitations: It matches a `testenv.deps` list in which no requirement is pinned with `==` in the parsed tox.ini; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A tox.ini that mentions a `testenv.deps` list in which no requirement is pinned with `==` in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
